title: Add podAntiAffinity rules for HA deployments
description:
**Severity: MEDIUM**

**File**: `deploy/k8s/base.yaml` — all Deployments and StatefulSets

**Issue**: Despite configuring HPA with multiple replicas, no podAntiAffinity rules exist. All replicas of a service can be scheduled on the same node, meaning a single node failure takes down the entire service — defeating the purpose of HA.

**Affected**: All Cordum Deployments (api-gateway, scheduler, context-engine, safety-kernel, workflow-engine, dashboard) and StatefulSets (nats, redis).

**Fix**: Add `preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution` podAntiAffinity with `topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname` to spread pods across nodes. Use `preferred` (not `required`) to avoid scheduling failures in small clusters.
definitionOfDone: All Deployments and StatefulSets have podAntiAffinity rules
Pods spread across different nodes when possible

implementationPlan.description:
**Create a kustomize patch** for podAntiAffinity at `deploy/k8s/production/patches/pod-anti-affinity.yaml`. This is better placed in the production overlay rather than base.yaml because anti-affinity is only meaningful in multi-node production clusters, not single-node dev environments.

The patch adds `preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution` anti-affinity to each Cordum Deployment using `topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname`, with weight 100. One strategic-merge-patch per Deployment:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cordum-api-gateway
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          - weight: 100
            podAffinityTerm:
              labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app: cordum-api-gateway
              topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
```
Repeat for: cordum-scheduler, cordum-safety-kernel, cordum-context-engine, cordum-workflow-engine, cordum-dashboard (6 Deployments). NATS/Redis StatefulSets in production already have their own pod specs.

Add the new patch to `deploy/k8s/production/kustomization.yaml` under the `patches:` section:
```yaml
  - path: patches/pod-anti-affinity.yaml
```
Also add anti-affinity to the NATS and Redis StatefulSets in their respective production files (`nats.yaml`, `redis.yaml`) using the same `preferred` pattern with their `app` labels.
Validate with `kustomize build deploy/k8s/production/` to verify all YAML is valid and the patches apply correctly.
